title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #15

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In which surah does Allah praise the Prophet's great character? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Qalam (68:4)
   D. Al-Masad

2. How should we treat a guest at the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore them
   B. Serve them first and respect them
   C. Give them the smallest share
   D. Eat quickly before them

3. Which hand should a Muslim use for eating? (1 mark)
   A. Left hand
   B. Right hand
   C. Either hand equally
   D. No hand, use a fork only

4. What did the Prophet do if he did not like a food? (1 mark)
   A. Complained loudly
   B. Insulted the cook
   C. Left it quietly without criticising
   D. Threw it away

5. What should you do before playing a sport? (1 mark)
   A. Warm up and drink water
   B. Sleep
   C. Eat a huge meal
   D. Skip water

6. Which value is learned from team games? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Teamwork
   C. Selfishness
   D. Cheating

7. What is the collection of Allah's most beautiful names called? (1 mark)
   A. Tajweed
   B. Sunnah
   C. Arkan
   D. Asma'ul Husna

8. What is a good manner of making dua? (1 mark)
   A. Begin with praise and end with Amin
   B. Ask only for toys
   C. Shout
   D. Never ask

9. Another name for the Angel of Death is (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Israfil
   C. Izrail
   D. Jibril

10. Which of these is NOT an angel duty? (1 mark)
   A. Recording deeds
   B. Bringing revelation by Allah's order
   C. Making rain by their own power
   D. Taking souls by permission

11. Who was the first prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Ibrahim
   B. Adam
   C. Nuh
   D. Musa

12. How is a light najasa cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it
   B. Wash seven times with soil
   C. Sprinkle water over it until it is wet
   D. Burn it

13. What does "najasa" mean? (1 mark)
   A. An impurity
   B. A food
   C. A journey
   D. A prayer

14. Which spots are often missed in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. The nose only
   B. The teeth
   C. Heels, elbows and behind the ears
   D. The top of the head only

15. Which of these does NOT break wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Urine
   B. Eating and drinking
   C. Passing wind
   D. Deep sleep lying down

16. Why must clothes and the prayer place be clean? (1 mark)
   A. It is not needed
   B. Purity is a condition of prayer
   C. It saves money
   D. It is a game

17. Roughly in which direction is the Qibla from most parts of Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Straight down
   B. North
   C. South
   D. West

18. Which posture is closest to Allah, according to the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Qiyam
   B. Sujud
   C. Ruku
   D. Taslim

19. When is the last tashahhud recited? (1 mark)
   A. In the final sitting
   B. In sujud
   C. In ruku
   D. In the first rak'ah

20. What do we say in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   C. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   D. Bismillah

21. Which animal do people in northern Kenya commonly use to carry loads? (1 mark)
   A. Camel
   B. Monkey
   C. Zebra
   D. Hippo

22. Which is a good habit for keeping the environment safe for animals? (1 mark)
   A. Leave litter
   B. Throw plastic in rivers
   C. Burn plastic
   D. Put rubbish in bins

23. In the Prophet's story, the man gave water to which animal? (1 mark)
   A. A horse
   B. A dog
   C. A cow
   D. A goat

24. Why should we not pollute rivers? (1 mark)
   A. Rivers are ugly
   B. Fish and other creatures live there
   C. Only people use rivers
   D. Fish do not matter

25. What did the Prophet say about modesty? (1 mark)
   A. It is part of faith
   B. It is a game
   C. It is weakness
   D. It is only for girls

26. Which of these fits the Islamic code of dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Torn on purpose
   B. Loose, clean and modest
   C. Very tight
   D. See-through

27. Which is a media plan? (1 mark)
   A. Games all day
   B. Screens at night
   C. No plan
   D. One hour after homework, no screens at prayer

28. What does "destitute" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A rich person
   B. A teacher
   C. A farmer
   D. A person who has nothing to live on

29. What did the Prophet say about the upper hand? (1 mark)
   A. It is better than the lower hand
   B. They are equal
   C. It does not matter
   D. It is worse

30. What is sadaqah? (1 mark)
   A. A game
   B. A tax
   C. Charity given to please Allah
   D. A loan

31. What is dua? (1 mark)
   A. Calling upon Allah and asking Him
   B. A journey
   C. A type of food
   D. A game

32. When should you say the dua for leaving? (1 mark)
   A. As you step out of the door
   B. After meals
   C. When going to bed
   D. At night only

33. Whom did the Prophet kiss when a man said he had never kissed his ten children? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. A stranger
   C. Ali as an adult
   D. His grandson Al-Hasan

34. What does "Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Praise Allah
   B. My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
   C. Say He is Allah
   D. Guide us to the straight path

35. What is the extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Only friends
   B. Only neighbours
   C. Relatives beyond parents and siblings
   D. Only parents

36. Which is a duty to grandparents? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid
   B. Ignore them
   C. Shout
   D. Help them and listen to their stories

37. Who is a "binamu"? (1 mark)
   A. Grandfather
   B. Aunt
   C. Cousin
   D. Uncle

38. What was the first word revealed? (1 mark)
   A. Pray
   B. Iqra (Read)
   C. Fast
   D. Give

39. Apart from Ibrahim, whose children were all the Prophet's children? (1 mark)
   A. Khadija's
   B. Hafsa's
   C. Safiyya's
   D. Aisha's

40. To which town did the Prophet go to invite people to Islam about ten years after the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. Taif
   B. Cairo
   C. Madinah
   D. Habasha

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the names of prophets in the family chain from Ibrahim to Yusuf. (3 marks)

42. Explain why the earliest converts are important. (3 marks)

43. Name the seven parts of the body that touch the ground in sujud. (3 marks)

44. When must a child not obey a parent, and how should the child still behave? (3 marks)

45. Suggest three honest ways of earning a living. (3 marks)

46. What does it mean that children are an amanah? (2 marks)

47. State the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in your own words. (4 marks)

48. State four conditions of swalah. (4 marks)

49. Explain the meaning of "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while there is good in both." (3 marks)

50. Why was the Prophet (S.A.W.) called Al-Amin? (3 marks)

51. Explain the hadith "The upper hand is better than the lower hand". (3 marks)

52. Suggest three ways to keep in touch with relatives who live far away. (3 marks)

53. State three things that do not nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

54. Explain the difference between patience and revenge with a school example. (3 marks)

55. How does the name Al-Malik help us to use our belongings wisely? (3 marks)

56. Write a dua using two of Allah's names and explain why you chose them. (4 marks)

57. Explain why parents should be fair among their children. (3 marks)

58. State three ways Khadija (R.A.) helped the Prophet (S.A.W.). (3 marks)

59. Explain why the Prophet (S.A.W.) is called Al-Amin and how a child can be trustworthy. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Al-Qalam (68:4)
   Surah Al-Qalam 68:4 speaks about his great standard of character.

2. B — Serve them first and respect them
   Hospitality is a Muslim value.

3. B — Right hand
   The Prophet taught eating with the right.

4. C — Left it quietly without criticising
   He never criticised food.

5. A — Warm up and drink water
   Warm-up prevents injuries.

6. B — Teamwork
   Working together builds teamwork.

7. D — Asma'ul Husna
   Asma'ul Husna means the Most Beautiful Names.

8. A — Begin with praise and end with Amin
   Dua begins with praise.

9. C — Izrail
   Izrail is commonly used for Malakul Maut.

10. C — Making rain by their own power
   Angels act only by Allah's command.

11. B — Adam
   Adam was the first human and prophet.

12. C — Sprinkle water over it until it is wet
   Sprinkling is enough.

13. A — An impurity
   Najasaat are impure things.

14. C — Heels, elbows and behind the ears
   Wash all parts carefully.

15. B — Eating and drinking
   Eating does not break wudhu.

16. B — Purity is a condition of prayer
   A valid prayer needs purity.

17. B — North
   Makkah lies to the north of Kenya.

18. B — Sujud
   A servant is closest in sujud.

19. A — In the final sitting
   In the last sitting.

20. C — Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   Glory to my Lord, the Most High.

21. A — Camel
   Camels carry loads in dry areas.

22. D — Put rubbish in bins
   Animals may eat plastic.

23. B — A dog
   Allah forgave him for it.

24. B — Fish and other creatures live there
   Pollution harms creatures.

25. A — It is part of faith
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

26. B — Loose, clean and modest
   Clothes should cover properly.

27. D — One hour after homework, no screens at prayer
   A plan sets limits.

28. D — A person who has nothing to live on
   Destitute means very poor.

29. A — It is better than the lower hand
   The giver is better than the receiver.

30. C — Charity given to please Allah
   Sadaqah is voluntary charity.

31. A — Calling upon Allah and asking Him
   Dua means supplication.

32. A — As you step out of the door
   At the time of leaving.

33. D — His grandson Al-Hasan
   The Prophet said whoever shows no mercy will not be shown mercy.

34. B — My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
   That is the meaning.

35. C — Relatives beyond parents and siblings
   Grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins.

36. D — Help them and listen to their stories
   Respect elders.

37. C — Cousin
   Binamu means cousin.

38. B — Iqra (Read)
   Iqra means read.

39. A — Khadija's
   All his children except Ibrahim were from Khadija.

40. A — Taif
   He went to Taif.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ibrahim, 1 for Ishaq and Yaqub, 1 for Yusuf in the right order.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: They believed when it was hard, supported the Prophet morally and materially, and encouraged others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Forehead with nose, two palms, two knees and toes of both feet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forehead, 1 mark for palms and knees, 1 mark for toes.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: When a parent commands something Allah forbids. The child should still treat them kindly and politely.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the case, 1 mark for not obeying, 1 mark for kindness.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Farming, trading in a kiosk, tailoring, carpentry, teaching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: A trust from Allah that parents must look after.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for trust and 1 mark for parents' care.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah is One. He is the Eternal Refuge whom everyone needs. He has no child and was not born. There is nobody equal to Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four verses.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Islam and sanity; purity; covering the awrah; facing the Qibla; the time has come.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each condition.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both types have good because of faith. But a strong believer can do more good, so a Muslim should try to be strong in body and faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for good in both, 1 mark for strong can do more good, 1 mark for the lesson.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: People trusted him with their valuables because he was honest and returned them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for keeping trust.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: The giving hand is better than the receiving hand. A Muslim should try to work and give rather than depend on others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for giver better, 1 mark for work, 1 mark for the lesson.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Call, send messages, send gifts, visit in holidays, attend family events.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eating, drinking, talking, laughing quietly, sweating.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience is staying calm and trusting Allah, while revenge is hurting back. If a classmate teases you, you stay calm and tell a teacher instead of fighting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for patience, 1 mark for revenge, 1 mark for example.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Everything belongs to Allah, so we should use what we have responsibly, share and be thankful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah as Owner, 1 mark for responsible use, 1 mark for sharing or gratitude.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: "Ya Rahman, Ya Rahim, forgive me and have mercy on me", because I need mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name, 1 mark for the request, 1 mark for the reason.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet told parents to fear Allah and be fair among children. Favouring one causes jealousy and hurt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for jealousy, 1 mark for fairness.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was first to believe, comforted him, supported him with wealth, stayed with him in hardship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: The people of Makkah trusted him with their valuables because he was honest. A child can keep promises, return borrowed items, and keep secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for two ways.
